ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white-to-light-gray pixels dominate approximately 82% of the visible ventral area, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels (approx. 18%) concentrated along the trailing edge perimeter and the central peduncle attachment zone.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation band (approx. 10-30 pixels wide) follows the entire trailing edge boundary. A vertical dark column originates at the median notch. Distinct dark linear mark located at coordinate region mid-right lobe. Sparse, small dark circular mottling points distributed across the lower-half of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe distal end shows larger jagged peaks compared to the more uniform, finely-serrated left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharp, tapered tips; the anterior edge (partially visible) suggests a broad convex sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, dark circular pixel groupings visible on the right lobe distal tip and scattered across the central-left lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant dark horizontal linear mark (rake mark) located on the mid-right lobe. Additional shorter, thinner diagonal linear disruptions visible in the central-right lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark horizontal rake mark on the right lobe; irregular trailing edge notch on the far-left tip suggests minor historical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark pigmentation 'anchor' shape at the center base where the fluke meets the peduncle, extending upward toward the median notch.
